_doc: 藥物頁人工查核紀錄（單一真實來源；2026-11-12 建，核心流程比照 TwTxGNN docs/_data/drug_reviews.json，欄位相同）。每筆＝一次查核：drug／file／claim（頁面原句）／replacement（更正後）／note（頁面上顯示的說明，本站語言）／finding（內部查證結論）／sources（網址＋查閱日）／checked（查核日）／action（correct 更正｜annotate 加註｜rereview 待重審｜section 附來源段落｜rereview_result 重審結果｜header_level｜description_level）。由 scripts/apply_drug_reviews.py 套到 docs/_drugs/*.md；改寫頁面的程式結尾都會重套，scripts/check_seo_docs.py 擋未套用的紀錄。原則：基本事實照本站主管機關資料更正；模型預測原文不刪不改寫，只加註；證據等級與決策只在重審結果為降級、升級或撤回時更新。2026-10-31～11-06 依新事實直接刪掉的矛盾子句，2026-11-12 由 scripts/reviews_from_edits.py 依 git 前後版本轉入（id 以 <站碼>-lic- 開頭）；報告在 11 月經 AI 重產、原句已不在頁面的標 status=resolved_by_regeneration。同 id 重發時前版存進 history（retired、reason），不覆蓋丟棄。

Acetaminophen doses of 150 mg/kg or greater have been associated with hepatotoxicity. Acetylcysteine probably protects the liver by maintaining or restoring the glutathione levels, or by acting as an alternate substrate for conjugation with, and thus detoxification of, the reactive metabolite of acetaminophen.
sources.translation: Acetylcysteine 已證實可減輕 acetaminophen 過量後肝損傷的程度。Acetaminophen 劑量達 150 mg/kg 或以上與肝毒性有關。Acetylcysteine 保護肝臟的方式，可能是維持或恢復穀胱甘肽濃度，或作為替代受質與 acetaminophen 的反應性代謝物結合，從而使該代謝物解毒。

In animal models, LIPITOR lowers plasma cholesterol and lipoprotein levels by inhibiting HMG-CoA reductase and cholesterol synthesis in the liver and by increasing the number of hepatic LDL receptors on the cell surface to enhance uptake and catabolism of LDL; LIPITOR also reduces LDL production and the number of LDL particles.
sources.translation: LIPITOR為HMG-CoA還原酶的選擇性、競爭性抑制劑；HMG-CoA還原酶為將3-羥基-3-甲基戊二醯輔酶A轉化為甲羥戊酸的速率限制酵素，而甲羥戊酸為包括膽固醇在內之固醇類的前驅物。在動物模型中，LIPITOR透過抑制肝臟中的HMG-CoA還原酶及膽固醇合成，並增加細胞表面肝臟LDL受體的數量以加強LDL的攝取及分解代謝，從而降低血漿膽固醇及脂蛋白濃度；LIPITOR亦可減少LDL的生成及LDL顆粒的數量。

sources.title: DailyMed: Vivimusta (bendamustine hydrochloride) prescribing information, Azurity Pharmaceuticals, Inc.
sources.excerpt: Bendamustine is a bifunctional mechlorethamine derivative containing a purine-like benzimidazole ring. Mechlorethamine and its derivatives form electrophilic alkyl groups. These groups form covalent bonds with electron-rich nucleophilic moieties, resulting in interstrand DNA crosslinks.
sources.translation: Bendamustine 是一種含有類嘌呤苯并咪唑環的雙功能 mechlorethamine 衍生物。Mechlorethamine 及其衍生物會形成親電子性烷基。這些基團會與富含電子的親核性部分形成共價鍵，進而造成 DNA 股間交聯。

[…] Cetuximab binds specifically to the EGFR on both normal and tumor cells, and competitively inhibits the binding of epidermal growth factor (EGF) and other ligands, such as transforming growth factor-alpha."（[DailyMed: Erbitux (cetuximab) prescribing information, ImClone LLC](https://dailymed.nlm.nih.gov/dailymed/lookup.cfm?setid=8bc6397e-4bd8-4d37-a007-a327e4da34d9)，版本日期 2026-04-16；查閱日期 2026-11-19）。

records.replacement: 根據美國 FDA 核准的 Irbesartan 處方資料（Prescribing Information）「Mechanism of Action」段（非官方翻譯）：「Angiotensin II是一種強效血管收縮劑，由angiotensin I經血管收縮素轉化酶（ACE，kininase II）催化的反應生成。Angiotensin II是腎素-血管收縮素系統的主要血管活性激素，亦是高血壓病理生理學中的重要組成部分。[…] Irbesartan透過選擇性結合存在於多種組織（例如血管平滑肌、腎上腺）中的AT 1 angiotensin II受體，阻斷angiotensin II的血管收縮及促進醛固酮分泌作用。」英文原文："Angiotensin II is a potent vasoconstrictor formed from angiotensin I in a reaction catalyzed by angiotensin-converting enzyme (ACE, kininase II). […] Irbesartan blocks the vasoconstrictor and aldosterone-secreting effects of angiotensin II by selectively binding to the AT 1 angiotensin II receptor found in many tissues (e.g., vascular smooth muscle, adrenal gland)."（[DailyMed: Avapro (irbesartan) prescribing information, Sanofi-Aventis U.S. LLC](https://dailymed.nlm.nih.gov/dailymed/lookup.cfm?setid=7885b2a8-be4e-48ab-8113-4e6ab791eb98)，版本日期 2026-08-24；查閱日期 2026-11-19）。

Once metronidazole enters the organism by passive diffusion and activated in the cytoplasm of susceptible anaerobic bacteria, it is reduced; this process includes intra-cellular electron transport donors such as ferredoxin and transfer of an electron to the nitro group of the metronidazole leading to formation of a short-lived nitroso free radical.
sources.translation: Metronidazole為一種nitroimidazole，在厭氧環境下對大多數絕對厭氧菌發揮抗菌作用。Metronidazole經被動擴散進入菌體，並於敏感厭氧菌的細胞質中被活化後，即被還原；此過程涉及細胞內電子傳遞供體（如ferredoxin），並將一個電子轉移至metronidazole的硝基，從而形成短暫存在的亞硝基自由基。
sources.translation_note: unofficial translation of the English excerpt (machine-assisted, 2026-11-19); the English original quoted on the page is authoritative

sources.excerpt: Pharmacodynamic Actions Pimozide tablets, are an orally active antipsychotic drug product which shares with other antipsychotics the ability to blockade dopaminergic receptors on neurons in the central nervous system. sources.translation: FYARRO 中的 sirolimus 為雷帕黴素機制標靶激酶（mTOR，舊稱哺乳動物雷帕黴素標靶）抑制劑。mTOR 是一種絲胺酸蘇胺酸激酶，位於 PI3K/AKT 路徑下游，控制細胞存活、生長及增生等關鍵細胞過程，且常在多種人類癌症中失調。在細胞內，sirolimus 會與親免素 FK 結合蛋白-12（FKBP-12）結合，形成免疫抑制複合物。

sources.excerpt: Tenofovir disoproxil fumarate is an antiviral drug. […] Tenofovir disoproxil fumarate is an acyclic nucleoside phosphonate diester analog of adenosine monophosphate. Tenofovir disoproxil fumarate requires initial diester hydrolysis for conversion to tenofovir and subsequent phosphorylations by cellular enzymes to form tenofovir diphosphate (TFV-DP), an obligate chain terminator.

XPO1 inhibition by selinexor leads to accumulation of TSPs in the nucleus and reductions in several oncoproteins, such as c-myc and cyclin D1, cell cycle arrest, and apoptosis of cancer cells."（[DailyMed: Xpovio (selinexor) prescribing information, Karyopharm Therapeutics Inc.](https://dailymed.nlm.nih.gov/dailymed/lookup.cfm?setid=f6dd2682-75a6-4863-90a8-a3197f6f78a8)，版本日期 2026-05-12；查閱日期 2026-11-20）。

sources.excerpt: Allopurinol is a structural analogue of the natural purine base, hypoxanthine.
